0022600150.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, 5-0 and first in the Southwest and the West, host the 0-5 Sacramento Kings, who are 15th in the West and on a five-game losing streak. Memphis is without Quinten Post, Scotty Pippen Jr., and Ty Jerome, who are all day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), all listed as out. The Grizzlies lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 123-112 win in Sacramento on October 25, and they also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
